email.subject: New message from Dr. Patel
email.body:
Hi Tomás,

Your wrist X-rays came back normal, no fracture or arthritis. This fits with tendinitis from repetitive strain. Keep the brace on while you're working, take naproxen 500 mg twice a day with food for up to 10 days, then only as needed. If it isn't better in 4 weeks, message us and I'll send a PT referral.

One more thing: the rough pink spot on your left forearm that we looked at is an actinic keratosis, which is early sun damage. Nothing urgent, but I want you using EltaMD UV Clear SPF 46 every morning on your face and forearms, and I'd like to recheck the spot in about 6 weeks.

Dr. Patel

notes.title: Portfolio review night notes
notes.body:
What I tell students every year:
- Lead with your 3 best projects, not chronological.
- Show the process for one project, not all of them.
- Say what the brief was in one sentence before you show anything.
- Real client work > class projects, even if it's small (menus, band posters).
- Cut anything you have to apologize for.
- PDF under 15 MB, name it firstname-lastname-portfolio.pdf.
